reflection_bit_order: The measurement map is reversed: q[0] maps to c[3], q[1] maps to c[2], q[2] maps to c[1], and q[3] maps to c[0]. The final qubit values in q[0]...q[3] order are [0, 0, 1, 0], so the classical bits become c[0]=0, c[1]=1, c[2]=0, c[3]=0. Qiskit displays count keys in c[3]c[2]c[1]c[0] order, which gives 0010.
reflection_bit_flip: The initial bits were [1, 0, 0, 0] and the seeded flip mask was [1, 0, 1, 0]. Applying X where the mask is 1 flips q[0] from 1 to 0 and q[2] from 0 to 1, so initial_bits XOR flip_mask produces [0, 0, 1, 0].
